en: Illustrated vintage postcard showing a tall stone monument or obelisk standing on a mound in a rural landscape. The name "JAHN" is carved near the top of the monument, which has a framed relief or plaque on its front. At the base stands a muscular, almost mythic-looking man with long hair and primitive clothing, holding a sword and shading his eyes as he looks up at the monument. Trees and distant hills appear in the background. The design is framed by a yellow border with printed text and a circular archival stamp in the lower left corner.
